variants.asks: every rule of the theory is a term, and every rule touches two things - the population and the space. What ARE the continuous equations, counted off the rules?

steps.via: the rays at a local, as the rules narrow it
steps.because: l is a point and its rays at once, so every rule's pattern narrows l to what the rule fires on, and the line counts those narrowings in l's rays: what one firing lights or takes, over how many of l's rays one match is. Creation fires on a point - all its ways at once, which is why `neutral` is the point's and counts every ray of it. A meeting fires on an edge, which l sees from its own end as a lit ray whose next ray is lit too, and it takes that one ray. A source lights the ways it emits on, which already says it is not moving. And Δ is the movement: following a ray a step and a tick, through the space standing where it goes - the rule that settles each tick is what makes it a difference at all.

derivation.via: an edge, seen from one of its ends
working: Edge.active = this.initial != None & this.terminal != None & this.initial.active & this.terminal.active
Ray.facing = this.terminal.across.ray: the ray across the same edge - next
derivation.because: an edge is active by its own definition: every end it joins is active. Seen from l, one of those ends is l's own ray and the others are across the edge from it - the ray `facing` reads, which is l's ray's next one. So a meeting is a ray of l that is lit and whose next ray is lit, and one meeting is as many of l's members as the definition has ends: 2.

the rule fires on an edge: its pattern, as a narrowing of l, is \narrow{l}{active & next.active}. One firing moves -2 on the rays, and one match is 2 of l's members, so each member of the narrowing moves -1.

working: one match is DEG of l
derivation.because: the rule fires on a point: its pattern, as a narrowing of l, is \narrow{l}{neutral}. One firing moves DEG on the rays, and one match is DEG of l's members, so each member of the narrowing moves 1.

working: pattern: Boundary\{emits & vertex.source.spare\} - of l: \narrow{l}{emits & vertex.source.spare}
derivation.because: the rule fires on a way: its pattern, as a narrowing of l, is \narrow{l}{emits & vertex.source.spare}. One firing moves 1 on the rays, and one match is 1 of l's members, so each member of the narrowing moves 1.

steps.via: the space at a local, as the rules narrow it
steps.because: the same narrowings, counted in the points that stand at l. A meeting folds one of its two ends into the other, so l, seen from one end, gains half a point a meeting; and a creation hands one point back, whatever l holds - a firing is one event on one point. What the world grows behind a meeting or ahead of a ray is a new local, not a point standing here.

derivation.via: the record is the space held
working: a meeting: one point held, one fold written
a creation: `if folds[d] > 0` on each of DEG ways is n_{f} folds off; `if held.last != None` is n_{f} points back - the same record, twice
so s - n_{f} does not move: s = 1 + n_{f}, a local holds itself and one point per fold
the population's transport, \paren{\nabla n_{f}}·\nabla_{\hat{d}} with 1/(1+n_{f}) kept, is steered by that record
derivation.because: the same firings move both ledgers, and nothing is handed back by decree. ANNIHILATION folds a point into the hub and writes one fold on the way it came by: one held, one written. CREATION lights every exit and unfolds - and unfolding is gated twice on the same record: a fold comes off a way only `if folds[d] > 0`, and a point comes back only `if held.last != None`, and a hub holds one point per fold it wrote. Read as the shares they are, the ways that lose a fold number n_{f} in expectation and so do the points that come back: the hand-back is what the gates come to on aggregate, not a line in the rule. So the space a local holds and the record it keeps move together, tick for tick, and their difference does not move at all. Integrated, s - n_{f} is a constant, and it is one: a local holds itself and one point per fold. THAT IS WHERE THE POPULATION'S LINE STANDS ON THE SPACE: it never names s, but its transport leans on \nabla n_{f} and keeps 1/(1 + n_{f}) of a heading, and its room ahead \omega is the share of ways whose far point is still there - both are the space, read through the record

kept straight at x: \frac{1}{1 + n_{f}} = \frac{1}{x.DEG + 1 - DEG_{0}}
steps.because: the lit share at l, followed a step and a tick: what it is one step on, along v, a tick later, less what it is here now. v is drawn at every place the ray passes, by that place's own ways - straight on at one against each folded way at its folds - so a place x keeps \frac{1}{x.DEG + 1 - DEG_{0}} of a heading straight and turns the rest across its folds. steps.via: the record settled against the density
steps.because: the record's line is linear in the record: a meeting writes a fold whatever l holds, a creation takes one off every way that holds one, and the more folds l holds the more ways it has to write them on. Where the record has stopped moving the line is nought, and it says what the record is at a density. It settles: the record's slope in its own line is what a creation takes back less what the extra way gives the meetings, and at the settled density that is below nought

steps.via: the record every body leaves at a local
working: the settled vacuum underneath: n_{f} at \rho_{\infty}, \frac{DEG_{0}·\rho_{\infty}^{2}}{4·\paren{1 - \frac{\rho_{\infty}^{2}}{4} - \rho_{\infty}}}
x = x_{@t}: every body at its own time, bound once in the sum; x.\bar{R} = l.distance\paren{x.l}, from the local now to the body then
steps.because: a meeting turns 2 of l's rays into a fold and a creation reads it back out, so l's rays, DEG of them a way, and 2 times its record move together: the meetings cancel out of their sum, and what is left is what the bodies put in and creation's share against the record l holds over its own ways - nought where the ways have settled, at \rho_{\infty}. So what a body puts in is never lost to the vacuum, only spread: what crosses the shell at a distance in a tick is what the body put out then, and the rays alone are the near field, what still arrives as rays, spread over the same shell - the record is the one less the other, so it is what the meetings took on the way, never less than nought, over 2, on the settled record. Each body is read as it was when its rays left it, at its own distance then

steps.via: the mass is what the vacuum leaves over
steps.because: the rays' line is linear in what a source puts in, so it solves for it: the share of l's ways a source lights is how the lit share at l moved, less what the vacuum's own rules did to it - put in by creation, taken by the meetings. Where the rays do only what the vacuum does, it is nought; anything else is a source
